_help: Shared Apps Script, the same one the Evershop-Unfulfilled and Evershop-RaisedBySumai portals post to. As of 2026-09-23 its GET says it only accepts sheet:'unfulfilled' and sheet:'raised', so a POST with sheet:'ycf' is refused and the portal falls back to saving feedback in the browser plus the Export button. To make it write straight to a sheet, add a 'ycf' case to that Apps Script project (it is already authorised by its owner, which a brand-new bound project would not be: Google answers an unauthorised web app with 'Access Denied', which in a portal looks exactly like a save that silently failed).
